title: Analyze nested Java method regions, not only top-level statements
wanted_capability: For Java methods dominated by large top-level loops/blocks, methodRegions should locate and gate nested statement clusters matching a marker instead of returning only the enclosing top-level statement.
missing_primitive: inner-scope/nested method region discovery and gating
fallback_used: Probe agent used content_search to find markers, manually read bounded source lines, then passed exact line ranges to analysis.methodRegions for gate-only validation.
notes: Sanitized from a private Java calculation-stage probe. Top-level statement filtering remains useful for UI/listener recipes, but nested calculation stages inside a giant loop need a marker-to-nested-range path.
resolution_note: Addressed with opt-in nested statement inventory: analysis.methodRegions accepts includeNestedStatementRegions and returns matching nested statement regions for marker searches inside giant enclosing loops/blocks, while preserving top-level-only default behavior.
